meta.title: AU Industry Role Taxonomy + CV Auto-Match Source
meta.purpose: Canonical role list per HQ.ai dashboard industry (extensive). Doubles as (a) the research worklist for the per-role rubric library and (b) the source data for the CV->role auto-matcher. Server-side only - NOT to be bundled into the client (see docs/specs/cv-scoring-and-role-matching-spec.md).

field_notes.role_key: Stable snake_case id. Rubric id convention: rub_<industry_prefix>_<role_key>_au_v1.
field_notes.rubric_id: Existing library rubric id, or null when the rubric is not yet authored (research pending).
field_notes.seniority: entry | skilled | lead | manager | professional - used for tie-breaking and to pick the right seniority variant.
field_notes.primary_award_code: Governing Modern Award (Fair Work). Some roles list an alt award in award_alt.
field_notes.positive_signals: Lowercased title/keyword tokens that INDICATE this role. Matcher scores overlap with CV job titles + skills.
field_notes.negative_signals: Tokens that look similar but should PUSH AWAY from this role (disambiguation).
field_notes.research_status: done (rubric authored + verified) | pending (needs full web research).

meta.matcher_contract: See spec section 4. The matcher never fabricates a role: below a confidence floor it returns null and the recruiter-selected role/JD is the source of truth.
